source.publisher: Irish News (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: read on the page image (Irish News, 19 May 1949, p. 3): 'Rathlin—Dan M'Conaig, Clare, Ballycastle'; 'Clare, Ballycastle' is his address, not part of the name. The paper's M'Conaig is entered under M'Couaig, the spelling of the 1946 and 1955 returns for Rathlin (Daniel M'Couaig, D. McCouaig)

note: Triennial election of the district electoral divisions of Ballycastle rural district, one member each. Nominations were lodged on 17 May 1949 and every candidate was returned unopposed, so no poll was held on 2 June 1949. The Irish News lists the eleven nominations it received. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Corrected from the page image of the Irish News, 19 May 1949, p. 3 (council-audit, Nov 2026): the name had absorbed his address ('Daniel M'Conaig Clare', surname Clare); the paper prints 'Dan M'Conaig, Clare, Ballycastle', entered as Daniel M'Couaig, the spelling of the 1946 and 1955 Rathlin returns, with the printed form kept.
